mapper.insert: insert into contract(a_link, a_contacts, amount, store_id, operator, signing_time, b_contacts, party_a, b_link, party_b, contract_id, obj_id, contract_name, start_time, end_time, state, contract_code, obj_type, operator_link, contract_parent_id, obj_name, obj_person_name, obj_person_id, start_user_id, partya_id, template_id, pay_mode) values (#{aLink}, #{aContacts}, #{amount}, #{storeId}, #{operator}, #{signingTime}, #{bContacts}, #{partyA}, #{bLink}, #{partyB}, #{contractId}, #{objId}, #{contractName}, #{startTime}, #{endTime}, #{state}, #{contractCode}, #{objType}, #{operatorLink}, #{contractParentId}, #{objName}, #{objPersonName}, #{objPersonId}, #{startUserId}, #{partyaId}, #{templateId}, #{payMode})

insert into contract_remind_log(log_id, contract_id, remind_type, channel, send_time, receive_tel, content, store_id, status_cd, create_time) values (#{logId}, #{contractId}, #{remindType}, #{channel}, #{sendTime}, #{receiveTel}, #{content}, #{storeId}, '0', now())
